name: routing-decomposer
description: Decompose, write, and grade the routing surface of a skill — its frontmatter description — on two crossing axes: INSTRUCTION (capability → scope → triggers → disambiguation → economy) and ROUTING (fires → holds → boundary → robustness → stability), scored separately so a description that reads well can't hide that it mis-routes. ROUTING routes to a deterministic eval (precision/recall/F1 against a labeled, adversarially-built corpus); INSTRUCTION gates on capability/scope honesty the eval can't see, pre-filtered by a static description linter. Backed by a gated rubric, a corpus + scorecard protocol, and before/after rewrites that move precision or recall.
